p=open('corpus.txt','rb').read().splitlines(); b=[x.split(b' ',1)[1].rsplit(b' ',1)[0] for x in p]; t=[collections.Counter(b[i::6]).most_common(1)[0][0] for i in range(6)]; f=bytes(x!=t[i%6] for i,x in enumerate(b)); exc=[x.split() for i,x in enumerate(b) if f[i]]; vocab=sorted(set(y for x in exc for y in x)); w=bytes(vocab.index(y) for x in exc for y in x); lens=bytes(len(x)-3 for x in exc)
print('original exception flag, lengths, words:',len(f),len(lens),len(w))
